content:
roc-overlay has existed for some time but I did not yet announce it here. It allows you to easily use Roc with nix by wrapping the nightlies and it avoids the long build from source that comes with the flake from roc-lang/roc.

roc-overlay was originally created by @blu :heart:
It has been fully manually reviewed by me and automatically by Claude.

PS: We also have a PR up on nixpkgs to get the roc package there updated to the new compiler.
